task_instance: Run the bundled CellProfiler bounded nuclei assay on a one-field 2D grayscale DAPI nuclear TIFF to produce the core deliverables: Count_Nuclei in Image.csv, per-object DNA intensity/area in Nuclei.csv, an outline overlay PNG, and assay_qc.json. The skill's documented invocation is 'python scripts/nuclei_assay.py prepare images.csv load_data.csv', then 'run images.csv results --executable cellprofiler', then 'summarize results'.
blocker_detail: The office-assistant runtime can only read/write/edit text files and fetch the web; it cannot run any code or shell command and cannot produce binary files. The skill's deliverable requires executing the bundled Python script (nuclei_assay.py prepare/run/summarize) and, for the actual segmentation, the separate CellProfiler 4.2.8 application/container run with '-c -r'. Even the input is blocked: the assay requires a real single-plane uint8/uint16 nuclear TIFF (a binary image), which this runtime cannot create, and segmentation output (nuclear counts, per-object intensities, overlay PNG) cannot be produced without running CellProfiler. The skill's own files (scripts/nuclei_assay.py, assets/nuclei.cppipe, references/runtime-and-qc.md) are all present next to SKILL.md, so the blocker is the runtime's inability to execute them, not missing skill files. No code-running or stubbing was done per the task rules.
